text: Everything so far has run off a file called agents dot md, sitting in the root of the project. Cursor read it. Copilot read it. Claude Code read it. Not one of them needed to be told it was there.

Which is the wider lesson, and it will matter long after this particular disagreement is settled. The convention is not the point. The brief is the point. If a tool wants it somewhere else, move it, and keep exactly one copy.
And the prompt is the same four words it has been all day.
